# Training Taper

Cutting training volume in the last one to three weeks before a race while keeping some speed work, so the body arrives rested but not stale.

## How I did it for the half

- Peak week ending 2026-04-12: 32 miles, long run 11 miles.
- Taper week 1 (from 2026-04-19): 24 miles, long run 8 miles, Tuesday intervals shortened to 4 x 800 m.
- Taper week 2 (from 2026-04-26): 14 miles plus race, two short easy runs and 3 x 400 m at race pace on Tuesday.
- Rough rule used: about 25% less volume the first week, about 50% less the second; intensity unchanged.

## Why it is in the vault

The 2019 half had no taper and I ran the last three miles a minute per mile slower. This time the last 3.1 miles were the fastest ([[pellbrook-river-half-2026-05-03]]). It is the one change I would keep for any future race ([[should-i-run-a-full-marathon-in-2027]]).

## Limits

This is what worked for one recreational runner on one plan ([[half-marathon-training-plan-v2]]), not a general rule.
